description: Combined tissue and liquid biopsy approach to maximize biomarker detection and uncover additional clinically actionable variants tied to targeted therapy decisions.
details: Solid Tumor Plus Liquid Biopsy helps maximize biomarker detection and identify more clinically actionable variants linked to targeted therapy options. In a metastatic pan-cancer analysis of 1,448 patients with actionable variants, 9 percent of patients had unique actionable alterations found in liquid biopsy that were not detected in solid tumor alone. This offering is useful when the care team wants broader molecular visibility, stronger therapy selection confidence, and a way to capture variants that may be missed by tissue-only analysis.

product_name: DNA Sequencing Plus Whole Transcriptome RNA Sequencing
description: Comprehensive DNA and RNA profiling designed to reveal actionable fusions and altered splicing that DNA-only testing can miss.
details: DNA Sequencing Plus Whole Transcriptome RNA Sequencing enables a more complete understanding of clinically actionable fusions and altered splicing. Twenty-one percent more patients with driver fusions eligible for FDA-approved targeted therapies were identified with DNA plus RNA sequencing compared to DNA sequencing alone. This product supports clinicians who need deeper molecular evidence, clearer treatment selection support, and better detection of driver events in complex or difficult-to-profile cases.

description: Tumor-normal matched sequencing that improves somatic calling accuracy and reduces false positives in precision oncology workflows.
details: Solid Tumor Plus Normal Match provides accurate insight through true identification of somatic alterations and helps maximize targeted therapy opportunities. The approach delivers a 28 percent reduction in somatic false-positive calls compared to tumor-only analysis. It is well suited for teams that want higher confidence in variant interpretation, cleaner molecular reporting, and more accurate downstream treatment planning.

description: Portfolio of MRD and monitoring assays for residual disease detection, recurrence tracking, and treatment response monitoring.
details: Minimal Residual Disease And Monitoring offers a portfolio of MRD and monitoring assays. It includes a finely tuned tumor-naive assay to help detect residual disease or recurrence in colorectal cancer, along with an ultra-sensitive assay to monitor residual disease and recurrence as well as IO treatment response. This product fits teams that want longitudinal monitoring, earlier detection of recurrence risk, and more precise follow-up visibility after treatment.

description: AI-enabled oncology platform combining algorithmic testing, digital pathology, and a large de-identified research record base to support data-driven decisions.
details: Robust AI Capabilities includes an expansive and developing portfolio of algorithmic testing capabilities and a digital pathology platform leveraging more than 8 million de-identified research records. It includes Tempus One, described as the first step toward artificial-intelligence-enabled genomic reporting, designed to help clinicians make more data-driven precision medicine decisions. This offering is a strong fit for teams seeking advanced analytics, scalable clinical insight, and AI-supported reporting workflows.

product_name: Single Platform Somatic Plus Germline Testing
description: Integrated somatic and germline testing designed to give a more complete molecular profile and identify hereditary cancer risk.
details: Single Platform Somatic Plus Germline Testing provides a comprehensive view of a patient's molecular profile and helps identify patients with hereditary risk through streamlined cancer testing. It supports clinicians who want a simpler ordering path, broader molecular visibility, and a more unified view of clinically relevant inherited and somatic findings.

description: Flexible genomic and pathology testing portfolio with IHC, neuro-oncology, and algorithmic assays that can be customized to the patient and disease context.
details: Tailored Testing Solutions provides a comprehensive selection of tests to help customize treatment for each patient. The portfolio includes IHC tests such as PD-L1 clones 22C3, 28-8, SP142, and SP263; MMR markers MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, and PMS2; HER2 with reflex testing to ERBB2 FISH in equivocal cases; support for HER2 ultra-low assessment in breast cancer; FOLR1, CLDN18, and c-MET. It also includes neuro-oncology tests such as 1p/19q co-deletion and MGMT promoter methylation, plus algorithmic tests including Immune Profile Score, Homologous Recombination Deficiency, Tumor Origin, DPYD, UGT1A1, and PurIST. This product works well when clinicians need tailored testing pathways, broader assay choice, and disease-specific decision support.

description: Streamlined ordering workflow for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies with one-checkbox ordering and configurable add-ons.
details: Simplified Ordering uses Comprehensive Therapy Selection to streamline testing for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies, allowing care teams to order tests specific to the patient's cancer type with one checkbox. It supports configurable add-ons such as liquid biopsy, hereditary testing, and MRD and monitoring assays, while preserving the flexibility to order individual tests as needed. This product is a strong fit for teams that want less ordering friction, clearer workflow standardization, and easier access to the right testing combinations.
